title: Another pdh bites the dust
intro_narrative: Summer hollowed out NUS SOC3—lights on, couches vacuumed, footsteps rare. Detective Lim Wei Jian signs in at the SOC3 security desk and follows Dr Siti Rahman to Level 3. Outside Prof Aishik’s office, lemon disinfectant hangs in the air. A flickering strip light and a toppled seminar stand frame a sealed door. What began as whispers of a fall quickly hardens into something else.

required_motive: Steal the qualifying rubric/past questions to avoid failing; silenced Prof Aishik when confronted.

phases.name: Phase 1 — The Body, Not a Fall
phases.objective: Establish cause of death by examining the scene and the body indicators in and around the office.

phases.name: Phase 2 — Missing Materials
phases.objective: Find what was taken and identify traces of after-hours access and recent contact with office equipment.

phases.name: Phase 3 — Alibis and Implements
phases.objective: Test suspect motives and opportunities: verify lab alibi, compare ropes, and connect chalk residue to office entry.

phases.name: Phase 4 — The Badge Event
phases.objective: Use keycard logs and forensics to confront the true culprit and establish motive, means, and opportunity.

NUS SOC3 Building lobby.description: A quiet, over-lit lobby with freshly vacuumed couches and a sterile, just-cleaned feel. The emptiness makes every sound—shoe squeaks, distant vents—carry too far.
clues: Security desk logs show only one after-hours office entry badge event besides Prof Aishik’s: Taha’s temporary access.

SOC3 Building corridor (Level 3).description: A lemon-disinfectant corridor with a flickering strip light near the stairwell and a toppled 'Research Seminar' stand. Doors sit closed like teeth—one of them guarded, untouched at the handle.
clues: Fresh powdery chalk/white dust is smeared on the office door handle, matching common lab board chalk.

Prof Aishik's office.description: A cramped academic office: bookcases packed tight, conference badges framed, and a desk facing a windowless wall. The air-conditioning is cold. The chair is toppled, the desk lamp knocked sideways, and Prof Aishik lies half-seated against the desk as if he tried to crawl away.
clues: A thin red groove and petechial spots on Prof Aishik’s neck indicate strangulation rather than a fall.
A length of utility rope with frayed fibers is found partly hidden behind the office cabinet baseboard.
The office chair is toppled and the desk lamp is knocked sideways, consistent with a struggle.
Prof Aishik’s keyboard shows a clear set of fresh fingerprints on the right side near the Enter key.
A hidden folder labeled “Qualifying—Rubric & Past Questions” is missing from the bottom drawer dividers.

clues: Yeet admits to a budget-cut argument but has a documented lab log-in during the presumed time of death.

clues: Fresh powdery chalk/white dust is smeared on the office door handle, matching common lab board chalk.

Detective Lim Wei Jian.role: Player-facing lead investigator; methodical, calm pressure, evidence-first reasoning.
Detective Lim Wei Jian.persona: Speaks in clipped, practical sentences. Asks single-purpose questions. Narrates deductions sparingly, letting objects and logs do the work.

knowledge_about_others.Dr Siti Rahman: Knows she is the faculty manager and cares about departmental reputation; relies on her for access and context.
knowledge_about_others.Yeet: Understands Yeet’s funding dispute could be motive but treats server logs as primary.
knowledge_about_others.Kuluhan Binici: Assumes Kuluhan is defensive due to profiling; uses rope comparison to clear or implicate.
knowledge_about_others.Prof Aishik: Respects the victim’s strictness; focuses on what the victim was protecting (the qualifying materials).

Detective Lim Wei Jian.abilities: Can perform structured interrogation, request/interpret access logs, and run a 'chain-of-evidence' recap that highlights missing links.

conditional_behaviors.reaction: Lim pushes for a named match to the fresh prints and reframes the case as targeted intrusion rather than a random altercation.

Yeet.role: Overworked graduate student with a public funding argument as apparent motive; provides alibi via lab logs.
Yeet.persona: Fast, defensive, sleep-deprived honesty. Offers receipts (logs) quickly, resents being reduced to a stereotype.

knowledge_about_others.Prof Aishik: Argued about budget cuts; believes Aishik was rigid and dismissive.
knowledge_about_others.Kuluhan Binici: Sees Kuluhan around; thinks supplies sometimes disappear but never asked directly.
knowledge_about_others.Dr Siti Rahman: Knows she enforces admin rules; assumes she’ll back faculty decisions.
knowledge_about_others.Detective Lim Wei Jian: Recognizes Lim is evidence-driven and tries to cooperate to clear suspicion.

Yeet.secret: Exploded in anger over funding and fears the argument will ruin their career, but did not go to the office during the time of death.

conditional_behaviors.reaction: Yeet points out timestamps and insists they were running a job; asks Lim to check server logs and camera angles.

Kuluhan Binici.role: Cleaner with access to supplies; rope ownership makes him an obvious but misleading lead.
Kuluhan Binici.persona: Gruff, blunt, preemptively offended. Speaks in short, sarcastic bursts; hates being suspected on job title alone.

knowledge_about_others.Prof Aishik: Saw him late sometimes; calls him 'strict' and 'always in a hurry'.
knowledge_about_others.Yeet: Knows students leave messes; doesn’t care about their politics.
knowledge_about_others.Dr Siti Rahman: Knows she handles complaints; assumes she’ll side with faculty.
knowledge_about_others.Detective Lim Wei Jian: Tests Lim’s professionalism; cooperates only when treated fairly.

Kuluhan Binici.secret: Has a petty side hustle selling extra trash bags to nearby offices; worries an investigation will expose it, but it’s unrelated to the murder.

required_evidence: Kuluhan Binici’s cleaning cart rope bundle
conditional_behaviors.reaction: Kuluhan insists the weave is different and the bundle is intact; mentions Taha once asked for 'spare string' and was refused.

Prof Aishik.role: Victim; appears as case-file presence (notes, context) and as the center of the missing qualifying materials motive.
Prof Aishik.persona: In documents and remembered speech: precise, strict, committee-minded, intolerant of shortcuts. Feels like a voice that policed standards.

knowledge_about_others.Dr Siti Rahman: Trusted her with admin logistics; kept certain materials locked for committee reference.
knowledge_about_others.Yeet: Knew about the lab funding conflict; considered Yeet volatile but capable.
knowledge_about_others.Kuluhan Binici: Barely acknowledged him; treated cleaning as background infrastructure.

Prof Aishik.secret: Kept 'Qualifying—Rubric & Past Questions' locked and restricted; suspected students would try to obtain it improperly.

Dr Siti Rahman.role: Faculty manager; provides access, institutional context, and procedural pressure (reputation, logs, timing).
Dr Siti Rahman.persona: Controlled, careful phrasing. Balances empathy with policy. Reveals facts reluctantly when they reflect badly on the department.

knowledge_about_others.Prof Aishik: Knows he was strict about locked materials and committee processes.
knowledge_about_others.Yeet: Knows the funding argument happened and was loud; unsure how far it went.
knowledge_about_others.Kuluhan Binici: Warned he can be grumpy but reliable; believes he’s often scapegoated.
knowledge_about_others.Detective Lim Wei Jian: Cooperates fully but tries to avoid panic among remaining students.

Dr Siti Rahman.abilities: Can authorize access to restricted rooms and retrieve administrative records (committee schedules, badge permission history).

conditional_behaviors.reaction: Siti confirms the temporary access policy and that only one non-Aishik after-hours entry appears—tightening the suspect pool to the badge holder.
